description: Read today’s saved Doctor picks and recent settled WON/LOST/PUSH results. Each item carries league (first leg’s league id), sport (first leg’s sport id) and leagues (every leg’s league), the same fields the app’s league tabs filter by, for every reader. Optional league (e.g. LGUE_nfl) and/or sport (e.g. SPRT_americanfootball) keep only matching items. Uses the app’s account permissions and paid-leg lock; no generation or current-price claim. Action and version are fixed by this tool; do not supply them.
name: get_doctor_picks
title: Read Doctor picks
